notes.title: Patch 1.11
notes.content:
Another small patch! I know I said the last one was probably going to be the last one, but this one cleans up a few minor issues I noticed watching streams and receiving feedback, and it shouldn't break save compatibility with 1.103. This'll be a little smoother, I hope! Like last time, the previous versions are available in the "betas" menu on Steam. [b]If you do end up having a save compatibility issue, this will let you roll back to the version your save was created on to finish reading![/b]

[list]
[*]Corrected a long transition in the misericord party scene.
[*]Corrected some stray mentions of early script location name "Grasmere" to "Linbarrow".
[*]Corrected a transition in Fire... Goat...! to include the redrawn mystery figure CG!!!
[*]Misc typo fixes.
[/list]

Onward to Volume 2...!

notes.title: Patch 1.103
notes.content:
A patch fixing some typos and other small issues is now live. There is a chance this update might break some saves; this is unfortunately unavoidable. I am dreadfully sorry for the inconvenience! Luckily, this should be a one-time thing. Saves that are close to chapter transition points are the most commonly affected. 

[h1]If your save is broken, there are two options to recover your position![/h1]

The first is to enable "Skip Unseen Text" in the Preferences menu, and to hold the skip key to get back to your previous point. I realize this will be a pain in the butt if you happen to have a broken save later in the story, but it will at least allow you to read the rest of the volume with the corrections.

The second option, if you're far in the story and don't want to skip back to where you were (understandable) is to activate the "beta" branch by right clicking the game in Steam, clicking Properties, and navigating to the Betas tab. The beta branch contains the previous version of the game, which won't have the typo corrections but will allow you to use your old save.

This is the only patch I have planned for the foreseeable future, and I'm making sure not to carry this issue forward into Volume 2 and beyond. I apologize again for the inconvenience. Mea culpa!

notes.title: Misericorde 1.101 update
notes.content:
Hey all! Here's the first post-release patch. This update is focused on fixing typos. I'm sure there's more to catch, but this fixes all the big ones people have sent me.

[list]
[*]Corrected various typos throughout.
[*]Removed extra spaces from the end of some lines.
[/list]

notes.title: First demo patch available!
notes.content:
Hey all! A patch for the demo is now available. It includes:

[list]
[*]Corrected error with date card placement.
[*]Corrected several typos.
[*]Corrected several text box issues.
[*]Adjusted screen tint in a few areas for readability.
[*]Fixed potential crash in Katherine's first scene. 
[/list]

A textbox in Japanese will appear when you next launch the game. Just click "OK" to continue through to the game! 

Thank you to everyone for checking the demo out, your feedback, and your support.
